name: app
description: A whole new app: core plus the entry files and Vite/TypeScript config (what `init` applies)
postInstall: Replace the remaining placeholders: <one-line German description> in index.html and vite.config.ts
Set the accent: --accent-h in src/lib/ui/theme.css (your slot from the 04-layout-system.md hue table) and the matching accent-600 hex as theme_color / <meta name="theme-color">
Add the PWA icons to public/: icon-192.png, icon-512.png, icon-maskable.png
Set compatibility_date in wrangler.toml to today and review public/_headers
